initialization: choose least samples_per_pixel, then geometry until every region has 16 spp; all methods use identical initialization
uniform: choose least samples_per_pixel, then geometry; no uncertainty or cost advantage
variance: V=mean RGB area-average within-pixel unbiased variance; index=V/(n*(n+4)); all-zero index falls back to least spp; no cost estimator or reference error

adaptive.name: explicit RGB/region batched MC-UCB adaptation; not an implementation of the full paper's scalar model
adaptive.beta_units: linear RGB radiance; fixed prototype exploration scale, not an inferred tail bound
adaptive.exploration: strictly positive beta bonus; repeated updates after each request, no zero-variance convergence declaration
adaptive.deviations: RGB variance scalarization, uniform per-pixel region batches instead of scalar arm pulls, 16-spp minimum instead of two pulls, equal-camera-cost error allocation rather than a global scalar integral
adaptive.confidence_limit: published sub-Gaussian confidence/regret bounds do not transfer to unbounded path radiance, heterogeneous pixels or batched RGB adaptation. No nominal confidence coverage or optimality claim; independently validate scale/applicability/competence before execution freeze

information: choose receives immutable allocation-only RegionState; no production image/error, reference, future sample, kernel or backend
streams: distinct allocation/production identities with same scene/frame/replicate, identical partition and mirrored requests; projected seeds checked; all policies pay both actual charges and elapsed work; pilots excluded from final image
stopping: fixed caller decision horizon only, at least four requests per region; never interpret as registered actual-ray checkpoint, target attainment or wall-time cap
estimator: production per-pixel native sample means, no reweighting/clamping. Separate pilots hide production radiance from allocation; stopping at path-dependent actual rays/time can still bias means and is an unresolved integration gate
failure: invalid or nonfinite state/config/request fails closed; incomplete paired work retained and marked unknown; no retry or scored image after failure
undefined: mean null at zero; variance/SE null below two; common minimum coverage resolves uncertainty before ranking; undefined variance after coverage is invalid
integration_gates: time cap and complete end-to-end timing
